title: Vellum AI Pricing in 2026 by Seats, Usage and Tokens
summary: Vellum AI pricing includes free and paid options at different levels. Compare plan features and limits to choose the tier that fits your needs.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Where the pricing body leaves gaps, these five questions pick them up. Each answer ends with where it comes from, and none comes with a figure.


### Does Vellum AI have a free plan?


Unconfirmed here. Even if a free tier exists, ask what it meters, whether that's seats, runs or workflow executions, because the meter decides how quickly you outgrow it and what the next tier costs. Source: unverified.


### Does Vellum AI charge for the models it runs?


Plan on paying for model tokens separately from the platform fee. That's the premise of this article, and it means your workload's prompt length and call volume set that line, not the plan name.


Whether Vellum passes provider rates through or lets you bring your own keys is unverified, so ask before you model the cost. Source: unverified.


### Can you self-host Vellum AI?


Treat self-hosting as a question for sales, not an assumption. If it exists, it's likely tied to a higher tier and a separate contract, so price it as its own line against the hosted plan. Source: unverified.


### Does Vellum AI offer discounts for startups or annual billing?


Ask for both in writing. Annual commitments change what you owe if your usage shrinks, because you pay for capacity you may not use. A startup program, if one exists, is worth asking about during the trial, before you commit. Source: unverified.


### How often does Vellum AI change its pricing?


There's no confirmed change history. The practical protection is to screenshot the pricing page the day you run your trial and attach it to your quote.


Then any later difference in seat counts, usage limits or token billing is something you can point to. Source: unverified.
